$comment: Conversations, one per key. `src/systems/dialogue.ts` walks `lines` in order and then, if there is a `question`, offers the two answers on keys 1 and 2. `face` names a preset in FACES, in src/systems/dialogue.ts. Ids are the contract: the tag on the NPC prefab picks the key.

lines.text: You are awake. Good. I was starting to talk to the chests.
The way out is the slab in the north wall. It is locked, and one of these chests has the key.

question.text: Shall I tell you which chest?

yes.text: The one in the middle of the floor. You are practically standing on it.

no.text: Suit yourself. Open both, then, and take the long way round.

lines.text: Do not mind me. I came in through the door and it shut behind me.
Press E at anything that looks like it opens. It usually does.
